pages.text: A reaper who has mastered the necromantic arts, it moves with the moonlight, rarely showing itself, quietly reaping souls. Only on the night of a full moon, at the moment you sound the horn, does it appear.

Compared with other necromancers, this mysterious one has a natural advantage in flight; its magic is not limited to summoning - it has poured magic into its own scythe, so it can fling out blade energy while also hurling phantom scythes, a considerable threat.$(br)Holding both reward and punishment, it can punish enemies and heal allies, reaping everything the enemy has.

pages.title: Broken Reaper Scythe
pages.text: After defeating the Reaper Necromancer you claimed its broken scythe. With this magic-laden blade you can create a Reaper Necromancer of your own, or quickly ascend it into a Dark Scythe.
